# 🐾 Antigravity Pet **A native Windows & macOS pixel desktop companion plugin for Google Antigravity — zero third-party runtime dependencies.** [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%2010%2F11%20%7C%20macOS%2012%2B-0078D6?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/Wlaeg/antigravity-pet) [![Engine](https://img.shields.io/badge/Engine-C%23%20WPF%20%7C%20Swift%20AppKit-38BDF8?style=flat-square)](app) [![Characters](https://img.shields.io/badge/Pixel%20Pets-8%20Built--in-F59E0B?style=flat-square)](pets) [![i18n](https://img.shields.io/badge/i18n-English%20%2F%20%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-10B981?style=flat-square)](#english) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-A855F7?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [English](#english) · [简体中文](#简体中文)
--- ## English **Antigravity Pet** brings a lightweight, reactive pixel-art companion directly to your Windows & macOS desktop while you work with **Google Antigravity**. Powered by a native transparent overlay (**C# WPF** on Windows / **Swift AppKit** on macOS), Antigravity lifecycle hooks, and an integrated Aux Pane Settings Panel (`...` menu & MCP App), it works out of the box with zero external SDKs or runtimes. ### ✨ Highlights - **Reverse Control: Double-Click Quick Dispatch & In-Bubble Approval** - **Double-click** the pet to open a quick prompt box and send tasks directly to Antigravity without switching windows (single-click still jumps straight to the active conversation via `antigravity://conversation/`). - High-risk commands intercepted via `PreToolUse` show **✓ Allow / ✕ Deny** buttons right inside the pet's pixel bubble (`45s` timeout safely falls back to `"ask"`). - **Screen-Edge Half-Body Peeking & Compact Status Block** - Drag the pet to the left or right edge of any display to dock it half-hidden with a `14°` peek tilt; the bubble simplifies into a `34×14` high-contrast status color block and smoothly expands back out on hover. - **Fullscreen Auto-Hide & Urgent Edge Peek** - Automatically hides during fullscreen games or videos, and peeks onto the screen edge without stealing focus whenever a task finishes (`Ready`), needs input/approval, or encounters an error (`Blocked`). - Optional **Snap to Antigravity Window** keeps the pet docked to the top-right edge of your IDE. - **Growth Pixel Accessories & Character-Specific Working Props** - Earn and equip frame-synced pixel **Glasses**, **Dev Cap**, **Coffee Cup**, and **Gold Crown** as you complete tasks; all 8 built-in pets feature custom animated working props and `themeColor` pixel bubbles. - **Zero Taskbar/Dock Clutter & Built-in Settings Panel (`...` Menu)** - Uses `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW` (Windows) and `LSUIElement` (macOS) with **`Win + Alt + P`** / **`⌥ + ⌘ + P`** global hotkey, **Launch with Antigravity**, EN/ZH auto-sync, **Detailed Stacked Bubbles** with `📌 Pin`, and one-click **`.zip` Custom Pet Pack v3 Import**. --- ### 🎭 Built-in Pixel Characters | ID | Display Name | Style & Personality | Pack Location | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `cyber-fox` | **CyberFox** *(Default)* | Neon cyan cyber fox with glowing accents | [`pets/cyber-fox`](pets/cyber-fox) | | `astro-bot` | **AstroBot** | Mini space explorer with animated visor | [`pets/astro-bot`](pets/astro-bot) | | `shadow-cat` | **ShadowCat** | Nimble dark cat with bright golden eyes | [`pets/shadow-cat`](pets/shadow-cat) | | `byte-ghost` | **ByteGhost** | Playful floating pixel spirit | [`pets/byte-ghost`](pets/byte-ghost) | | `shiba-dog` | **ShibaDog** | Warm golden Shiba Inu companion | [`pets/shiba-dog`](pets/shiba-dog) | | `pixel-dragon` | **PixelDragon** | Emerald mini dragon with golden horns | [`pets/pixel-dragon`](pets/pixel-dragon) | | `android-bugdroid` | **Android Bugdroid** | Classic Google Android green robot mascot | [`pets/android-bugdroid`](pets/android-bugdroid) | | `flutter-dash` | **Flutter Dash** | Official Google Flutter & Dart blue bird mascot | [`pets/flutter-dash`](pets/flutter-dash) | > Custom v3 pet packs (`themeColor`, custom `.wav` `sounds`, or per-action frame folders) can be imported directly via **Import .zip** in the Settings Panel, or placed inside `%USERPROFILE%\.antigravity-pet\pets\\`. --- ### 🔔 Multi-Session Priority & Status Machine When multiple Antigravity conversations run concurrently, the pet arbitrates display state strictly by priority: | Priority | State | Trigger (`hooks.json`) | Visual & Bubble Feedback | | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1** | `Needs Input` | User confirmation / question required | Amber halo + `!` badge + prompt bubble + optional chime | | **2** | `Blocked` | Tool error or execution failure | Red halo + `✕` badge + error bubble (click to inspect) | | **3** | `Ready` | Agent task finishes (`Stop`) | Green celebration loop + `✓` badge + clickable completion bubble | | **4** | `Running` | Thinking, file edits, commands (`PreInvocation` / `PostToolUse`) | Cyan halo + busy working animation + live step bubble | | **5** | `Idle` | No active tasks | Gentle breathing + idle desktop roaming + 16-dir eye follow | --- ### 🧩 Architecture & Project Structure ```mermaid flowchart LR AGY["Google Antigravity"] -->|hooks.json| Bridge["scripts/hook-bridge.mjs"] AGY -->|Aux Pane sidecar://| Panel["sidecars/panel/server.mjs"] AGY -->|MCP App ui://| MCP["scripts/pet-mcp-server.mjs"] Panel -->|Renders UI| PUI["sidecars/panel/index.html"] Bridge -->|HTTP 127.0.0.1:47821| Pet["AntigravityPet (WPF / AppKit)"] Panel -->|HTTP / config.json| Pet MCP -->|HTTP / config.json| Pet Pet -->|Click Bubble or Pet| DeepLink["OS Focus + antigravity://conversation/id"] DeepLink --> AGY ``` ```text antigravity-pet/ ├── app/ │ ├── AntigravityPet.cs # Windows native WPF overlay, HTTP server & hotkey │ ├── AntigravityPet.exe # Prebuilt zero-dependency Windows executable │ └── AntigravityPet.swift # macOS native AppKit overlay, HTTP server & hotkey ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Plugin icon │ └── preview.svg # Repository showcase banner ├── pets/ # 6 built-in 8x11 pixel-art sprite packs ├── scripts/ │ ├── generate-default-pets.ps1 # Procedural 36x39 pixel-art spritesheet generator │ ├── hook-bridge.mjs # Cross-platform Antigravity hooks -> HTTP bridge │ └── pet-mcp-server.mjs # Cross-platform MCP server + MCP App UI provider ├── sidecars/panel/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Aux Pane integration manifest (... menu) │ ├── server.mjs # Cross-platform Sidecar backend & auto-launcher │ └── index.html # Bilingual settings panel UI ├── skills/ │ ├── pet/SKILL.md # Skill guide for controlling the desktop pet │ └── hatch-pet/SKILL.md # Skill guide for generating custom pixel pets ├── ui/settings.html # MCP App standalone settings UI ├── build.ps1 # Windows one-click builder & launcher ├── build.sh # macOS one-click Swift compiler & .app packager ├── hooks.json # Antigravity hook bindings ├── mcp_config.json # MCP server configuration ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest └── README.md ``` --- ### 🚀 Installation & Quick Start #### Windows 10 / 11 1. Clone or copy this repository into your Antigravity plugins directory: ```text %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pet\ ``` 2. Run the one-click build & launch script (uses built-in `.NET Framework 4.x` `csc.exe`, **no extra SDK required**): ```powershell cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pet" .\build.ps1 -Launch ``` 3. Reload or open **Google Antigravity**, then click **`...`** at the top-right to open **Desktop Pet Settings** (or press **`Win + Alt + P`** anytime to toggle visibility). #### macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) 1. Clone or copy this repository into your Antigravity plugins directory: ```text ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pet/ ``` 2. Run the one-click Swift build & launch script (uses macOS built-in `swiftc`, **no extra SDK required**): ```bash cd ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pet chmod +x build.sh && ./build.sh --launch ``` *(If Xcode Command Line Tools are not installed yet, run `xcode-select --install` first. Antigravity hooks will also auto-compile on first start.)* 3. Open **Google Antigravity**, click **`...`** at the top-right for **Desktop Pet Settings**, or press **`⌥ + ⌘ + P`** (`Option + Command + P`) anytime to show/hide. --- ### 🎨 Custom Pet Spritesheet Specification (`v2`, `8×11` Grid) Each custom pet pack only requires two files: `pet.json` and `spritesheet.png` (32-bit RGBA transparent PNG, `1536×2288 px`, each cell `192×208 px`): ```json { "id": "my-pet", "displayName": "MyPet", "description": "Custom pixel companion", "spriteVersionNumber": 2, "spritesheetPath": "spritesheet.png" } ``` | Row | Animation State | Recommended Frames | Notes | | :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- | | `0` | `idle` | 6 | Gentle idle breathing & blinking | | `1` | `running-right` | 8 | Walking right during desktop roaming | | `2` | `running-left` | 8 | Walking left during desktop roaming | | `3` | `waving` | 4 | Friendly wave (triggered on cursor greeting) | | `4` | `jumping` | 5 | Joyful jump animation | | `5` | `failed` | 8 | Error / blocked state (`Blocked`) | | `6` | `waiting` | 6 | Waiting for confirmation (`Needs Input`) | | `7` | `running` | 6 | Busy working animation (`Running`) | | `8` | `review` | 6 | Task completion celebration (`Ready`) | | `9–10` | `look-directions` | 16 (8 + 8) | Clockwise gaze directions (0 = Right, 4 = Down, 8 = Left, 12 = Up) | --- ### 🌐 Local HTTP Control API (`http://127.0.0.1:47821`) | Endpoint | Method | Description | Example Payload | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `/health` | `GET` | Returns running status, i18n language, full config, stats, recent chats, and pet list | — | | `/state` | `POST` | Updates conversation state (`idle` / `running` / `needs_input` / `ready` / `blocked`) | `{"conversationId":"abc","state":"running","message":"Thinking..."}` | | `/skin` | `POST` | Switches the active character pack | `{"skin":"cyber-fox"}` | | `/reload` | `POST` | Hot-reloads pet packs from `pets/` and `%USERPROFILE%\.antigravity-pet\pets\` | `{}` | | `/control` | `POST` | Executes window & config actions (`show`/`hide`/`toggle`/`open`/`quit`/`language`/`scale`/`bubbleMode`/`updateConfig`) | `{"action":"language","value":"en"}` | --- ## 简体中文 **Antigravity Pet** 是专为 **Google Antigravity** 打造的原生跨平台（**Windows & macOS**）像素风桌面宠物插件。Windows 端基于原生 C# WPF 透明悬浮窗（`WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW`），macOS 端基于原生 Swift AppKit 悬浮窗（`LSUIElement`），结合 Antigravity 生命周期 Hooks 与客户端右上角 `...` 内置设置面板，**零第三方运行时依赖，开箱即用**。 ### ✨ 核心亮点 - **反向控制：双击快捷派活 & 气泡快捷审批** - **双击桌宠本体** 即可呼出极简指令框直接向 Antigravity 派活（内置 `240ms` 防冲突保护，单击仍正常跳转关联对话）。 - 通过 `hooks.json` (`PreToolUse`) 拦截高危命令时，桌宠头顶气泡直接弹出 **✓ 允许 / ✕ 拒绝** 按钮（45 秒超时自动回退系统确认）。 - **左右贴边半身观察 & 极简状态色块** - 将宠物拖到当前屏幕左/右边缘（或通过右键「📌 屏幕贴边停靠」），宠物自动藏起半身并微倾 `14°` 观察；收起时聊天框精简为 `34×14` 高对比度状态色块，鼠标悬停即平滑探出显示完整气泡。 - **全屏自动避让 & 关键提醒贴边弹出** - 全屏游戏或看视频时自动隐藏避让；一旦出现任务完成（`Ready`）、需要输入/审批或报错（`Blocked`），立即无焦点置顶贴边弹出提醒，处理后自动收回。支持可选 **吸附 Antigravity 窗口** 边缘。 - **成长像素配饰 & 8 款角色专属工作抱物** - 随完成任务数自动解锁（或手动佩戴）**像素墨镜、鸭舌帽、咖啡杯、黄金皇冠**，帧级合成进角色动画层并同步左右镜像与拖拽物理效果；8 款内置角色均配备专属 `1px` 描边工作抱物与类像素风主题色气泡。 - **零任务栏/Dock 干扰 & 专业内置设置面板** - Windows `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW` / macOS `LSUIElement` 零图标驻留，支持 **`Win + Alt + P`** / **`⌥ + ⌘ + P`** 全局热键、随 Antigravity 启停、中英文自动跟随、**详细堆叠气泡 + `📌` 会话固定**，以及 **`.zip` 自定义宠物包一键导入**。 --- ### 🎭 内置 8 款像素角色图鉴 | 皮肤 ID | 角色名称 | 外观特色 | 目录位置 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `cyber-fox` | **小蓝狐 CyberFox** *(默认)* | 赛博蓝荧光耳廓与灵动眼神 | [`pets/cyber-fox`](pets/cyber-fox) | | `astro-bot` | **像素宇航员 AstroBot** | 发光头盔护目镜与太空服造型 | [`pets/astro-bot`](pets/astro-bot) | | `shadow-cat` | **小黑猫 ShadowCat** | 金瞳神秘黑猫与精致铃铛 | [`pets/shadow-cat`](pets/shadow-cat) | | `byte-ghost` | **电子幽灵 ByteGhost** | 半透明霓虹飘浮小幽灵 | [`pets/byte-ghost`](pets/byte-ghost) | | `shiba-dog` | **像素柴犬 ShibaDog** | 暖黄色蓬松柴犬伙伴 | [`pets/shiba-dog`](pets/shiba-dog) | | `pixel-dragon` | **像素小青龙 PixelDragon** | 翡翠绿身躯配金色小龙角 | [`pets/pixel-dragon`](pets/pixel-dragon) | | `android-bugdroid` | **安卓小绿人 Bugdroid** | Google Android 官方经典绿色小机器人 | [`pets/android-bugdroid`](pets/android-bugdroid) | | `flutter-dash` | **Flutter 小蓝鸟 Dash** | Google Flutter & Dart 官方吉祥物小蓝鸟 | [`pets/flutter-dash`](pets/flutter-dash) | > 支持在设置面板点击 **「导入宠物包」** 一键上传 `.zip`（支持 v3 `themeColor`、自定义 `.wav` 音效与分动作序列帧目录），或直接放入 `%USERPROFILE%\.antigravity-pet\pets\\` 热重载启用。 --- ### 🔔 多会话状态仲裁与视觉反馈 当多个 Antigravity 对话并行执行时，桌宠严格按以下优先级展示最高优先级的会话状态： | 优先级 | 状态 | 触发场景 (`hooks.json`) | 桌宠表现与交互 | | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1** | `Needs Input` | Agent 需要用户审批或回答问题 | 琥珀色光环 + `!` 徽章 + 提示气泡 + 可选轻柔提示音 | | **2** | `Blocked` | 工具调用报错或执行阻断 | 红色光环 + `✕` 徽章 + 报错气泡，点击直达排查 | | **3** | `Ready` | 任务完成 (`Stop`) | 绿色光环 + 庆祝动画 + `✓` 徽章，点击打开结果对话 | | **4** | `Running` | 思考规划、读写文件、运行命令 | 冰蓝色光环 + 忙碌动画 + 实时进度气泡 | | **5** | `Idle` | 所有会话空闲 | 呼吸眨眼 + 每隔十几秒桌面散步 + 16 方向眼神跟随 | --- ### 🚀 安装与一键编译指南 #### Windows 10 / 11 1. 克隆或复制本项目到 Antigravity 插件目录： ```text %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pet\ ``` 2. 执行一键构建与启动脚本（直接调用 Windows 自带 `.NET Framework 4.x` `csc.exe`，**无需安装额外 SDK**）： ```powershell cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pet" .\build.ps1 -Launch ``` 3. 打开 **Google Antigravity**，点击右上角 **`...`** 插件菜单即可打开 **「桌面宠物设置」** 面板；随时可使用快捷键 **`Win + Alt + P`** 显隐桌宠。 #### macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) 1. 克隆或复制本项目到 Antigravity 插件目录： ```text ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pet/ ``` 2. 执行一键编译与启动脚本（调用系统自带 `swiftc` 编译为 `.app` 悬浮应用，**无需安装额外 SDK**）： ```bash cd ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pet chmod +x build.sh && ./build.sh --launch ``` *（若未安装命令行编译工具，系统提示时执行 `xcode-select --install` 即可；后续在 Antigravity 触发 Hooks 时也会自动检测并编译启动。）* 3. 打开 **Google Antigravity**，点击右上角 **`...`** 打开 **「桌面宠物设置」**，或随时按 **`⌥ + ⌘ + P`**（`Option + Command + P`）显隐桌宠。 --- ### 🌐 本地 HTTP 控制接口 (`http://127.0.0.1:47821`) | 接口 | 方法 | 说明 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | `/health` | `GET` | 返回运行状态、多语言设置、全量配置、统计数据、最近会话列表与宠物列表 | | `/state` | `POST` | 更新指定 `conversationId` 的任务状态（`idle`/`running`/`needs_input`/`ready`/`blocked`） | | `/skin` | `POST` | 切换宠物角色皮肤（如 `{"skin": "cyber-fox"}`） | | `/reload` | `POST` | 热重载 `pets/` 与 `%USERPROFILE%\.antigravity-pet\pets/` 宠物包 | | `/control` | `POST` | 执行窗口与配置控制（`show`/`hide`/`toggle`/`open`/`quit`/`language`/`scale`/`bubbleMode`/`updateConfig`） | --- ### ❓ 常见问题 (FAQ) - **Q：为什么 Windows 任务栏或 macOS Dock 栏里看不到桌宠？** - A：这是特意设计的纯净悬浮模式（Windows 使用 `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW`，macOS 使用 `LSUIElement` + `.accessory`），避免占用任务栏、托盘与 Dock 空间。你可以通过右键桌宠、快捷键 `Win + Alt + P`（macOS 为 `⌥ + ⌘ + P`）或 Antigravity 右上角 `...` 的 **「桌面宠物设置」** 随时管理。 - **Q：如何关闭开机随 Windows 启动，仅在使用 Antigravity 时运行？** - A：新版已彻底移除 Windows 开机自启注册表项，默认即为 **「随 Antigravity 启动」**（打开客户端时拉起、关闭客户端时自动退出）。 - **Q：支持自定义生成新宠物吗？** - A：支持！直接在对话中对 Antigravity 说「帮我孵化一只赛博小熊猫桌面宠物」，内置 `hatch-pet` 技能即可为你生成完整 `8×11` 图集与 `pet.json` 并热切换。 --- ### 📄 开源协议 本项目基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。

`WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW`，macOS 使用 `LSUIElement` + `.accessory`），避免占用任务栏、托盘与 Dock 空间。你可以通过右键桌宠、快捷键 `Win + Alt + P`（macOS 为 `⌥ + ⌘ + P`）或 Antigravity 右上角 `...` 的 **「桌面宠物设置」** 随时管理。 - **Q：如何关闭开机随 Windows 启动，仅在使用 Antigravity 时运行？** - A：新版已彻底移除 Windows 开机自启注册表项，默认即为 **「随 Antigravity 启动」**（打开客户端时拉起、关闭客户端时自动退出）。 - **Q：支持自定义生成新宠物吗？** - A：支持！直接在对话中对 Antigravity 说「帮我孵化一只赛博小熊猫桌面宠物」，内置 `hatch-pet` 技能即可为你生成完整
